La coliflor pasa de cruda a puré en un m: Cauliflower goes from raw to purée in a minute, and past that it turns slimy and smells of sulphur. Cook it briefly or roast it.
LA GRANOLA VA LA ÚLTIMA Y JUSTO ANTES DE: THE GRANOLA GOES IN LAST AND JUST BEFORE EATING. Mixed in early it softens and loses the one thing it brings, which is the crunch.
La granola, por encima y justo antes de: The granola on top and just before eating, so it arrives crunchy.
La granola, por encima y JUSTO ANTES DE: The granola on top and JUST BEFORE EATING, so it arrives crunchy.
The granola on top and JUST BEFORE EATING.
La mantequilla de cacahuete tiene que es: The peanut butter needs to be at room temperature, soft. If it is hard from the fridge, dip the spoon in hot water for 10 seconds.
La merluza al vapor se pasa en menos de: Steamed hake overcooks in under a minute and goes dry and leathery, so check it at 7 minutes.
La proporción es lo único que importa en: The ratio is the only thing that matters in a porridge: THREE parts liquid to ONE of oats. With 70 g of oats, about 210 ml of water or milk.
La tortita de arroz se parte si aprietas: A rice cake snaps if you press it: it is compressed air. All of this is about not breaking it.
LA VUELTA: pon un plato plano más ancho: THE TURN: put a flat plate wider than the pan on top, hold it down with your palm and flip both together in one decisive movement. Hesitation is what breaks it.
THE TURN: put a flat plate wider than the pan on top, hold it down with your palm, and flip both together in one decisive movement. Hesitation is what breaks it.
Lamina 3 o 4 dientes de ajo y dóralos en: Slice 3 or 4 cloves of garlic and brown them in a pot with three tablespoons of oil over a medium-low heat, 2 minutes, without burning them.
Lamina 4 o 5 dientes de ajo y dóralos DE: Slice 4 or 5 cloves of garlic and brown them SLOWLY in two tablespoons of oil over a medium-low heat, 2 minutes, without letting them burn.
Lamina 4 o 5 dientes de ajo. Ponlos en u: Slice 4 or 5 cloves of garlic. Put them in a pan with two tablespoons of oil over a MEDIUM-LOW heat and let them brown slowly for 2 minutes: in very hot oil garlic burns and turns bitter.
Lamina el ajo y dóralo despacio en una s: Slice the garlic and brown it slowly in a wide pan with two tablespoons of oil over a medium-low heat, 2 minutes.
Lamina el ajo y ponlo en una sartén con: Slice the garlic and put it in a pan with two tablespoons of oil over a medium-low heat; as soon as it starts to colour, turn the heat up and add the mushrooms.
Langostinos cocidos pelados, 1 minuto so: Cooked peeled king prawns, 1 minute just to warm through. Overcooked = leathery.
Langostinos cocidos pelados, templados 1: Cooked peeled king prawns, warmed for 1 minute in a pan with a teaspoon of oil. No longer.
Las almendras van al final para que no s: The almonds go in at the end so they do not go soft.
Las claras cuajan más rápido que el huev: Whites set faster than whole egg and dry out at the slightest thing. Take them off as soon as no clear liquid is left, while they are still glossy.
Las espinacas frescas sueltan mucha agua: Fresh spinach releases a lot of water. Put it straight into the whites and the scramble comes out watery.
Las gambas YA ESTÁN COCIDAS: 45 segundos: The prawns ARE ALREADY COOKED: 45 seconds in the pan just to warm them, not a second more or they turn to rubber.
Las gambas YA VIENEN COCIDAS: solo hay q: The prawns COME READY COOKED: they only need warming. Put them in a pan with a teaspoon of oil over a medium heat.
Las lentejas ya vienen cocidas de bote:: Tinned lentils come ready cooked: rinse them in a colander under the tap until the water runs clear. That thick liquid from the tin tastes tinny.
Las sardinas de lata YA ESTÁN cocidas: s: Tinned sardines ARE already cooked: they are drained and flaked, and go in at the end. The backbone is soft and perfectly edible.
Las verduras congeladas van a la sartén: Frozen vegetables go into the pan STILL FROZEN and over a high heat: thawed they release water and stew instead of browning.
Las verduras congeladas y el tomate suel: Frozen vegetables and tomato release a lot of water. Put them straight into the whites and the omelette turns to soup.
Lava el pepino y córtalo en bastones par: Wash the cucumber and cut it into similar sticks. If the skin is very thick or bitter, peel it in stripes, leaving some skin on.
Lava el pepino y córtalo en dados pequeñ: Wash the cucumber and cut it into small cubes. If it releases a lot of water, leave it 5 minutes in a colander with a pinch of salt and drain it.
Lava el tomate y córtalo en dados de un: Wash the tomato and cut it into a couple of centimetre cubes.
Lava el tomate y córtalo en rodajas de m: Wash the tomato and cut it into half-centimetre slices.
Lava el tomate y córtalo en rodajas fina: Wash the tomato and cut it into thin slices, or grate it on the coarse side, holding it by the skin.
Wash the tomato and cut it into thin slices, or grate it if you prefer it the classic toast way.
Wash the tomato and cut it into thin slices.
Lava el tomate, córtalo en rodajas finas: Wash the tomato, cut it into thin slices and lay them on top.
Lava el tomate, córtalo en rodajas y sír: Wash the tomato, slice it and serve it alongside the toast.
Lava el tomate, el pepino y el pimiento: Wash the tomato, the cucumber and the pepper and chop them. Remove the seeds and the white pith from the pepper (it is bitter).
Rinse the apple under the tap and dry it.
Lava la manzana, quítale el corazón con: Wash the apple, cut out the core with the pips and cut it into small cubes, about the size of a dice.
Lava la manzana, quítale el corazón y có: Wash the apple, core it and cut it into small cubes with the skin on.
Wash the apple, core it and cut it into small cubes.
Wash the apple, core it and cut it into small cubes. There is no need to peel it: the skin has fibre.
Wash the apple, core it and cut it into wedges a finger thick.
Wash the apple, core it and cut it into thin wedges.
Lava las fresas ENTERAS, con el rabito p: Wash the strawberries WHOLE, with the hulls still on, and dry them: hull them before washing and they fill with water inside and end up tasteless.
Lava los tomates y córtalos en rodajas d: Wash the tomatoes and cut them into slices of about half a centimetre.
Lava los tomates y córtalos por la mitad: Wash the tomatoes and cut them in half. If they roll as you cut, rest them on the cut side.
Lava los tomatitos y córtalos por la mit: Wash the cherry tomatoes and cut them in half.
Lava y corta el tomate en dados pequeños: Wash the tomato, cut it into small cubes and let it drain a moment: if it goes in soaking, the omelette will not set.
Lava y corta el tomate en gajos y mézcla: Wash the tomato, cut it into wedges and mix it with the lettuce.
Lava y corta el tomate y el pepino en da: Wash the tomato and cucumber and cut them into cubes of the same size: in a salad you eat with a spoon, everything has to fit together.
Lava y pela la zanahoria y córtala en ba: Wash and peel the carrot and cut it into sticks a finger thick, firm enough not to snap when you dip them.
Lava y pela la zanahoria y córtala en ro: Wash and peel the carrot and cut it into thin rounds, half a centimetre: any thicker and they will not cook in the time this takes.
Lava y pela la zanahoria y el pepino, y: Wash and peel the carrot and the cucumber, and cut them into thin sticks, as long as the wrap.
Lava y trocea el tomate. Saltéalo en la: Wash and chop the tomato. Fry it in the pan with a tablespoon of oil for 4 minutes over a medium heat, until it breaks down.
Limón y pimienta. La caballa ya sala, pr: Lemon and pepper. The mackerel is already salty, taste it first.
Limón, pimienta y un hilo de aceite crud: Lemon, pepper and a drizzle of raw oil.
Limpia los champiñones con papel húmedo: Wipe the mushrooms with damp kitchen paper (not under the tap, they soak up water) and quarter them.

Wipe the mushrooms with damp kitchen paper (not under the tap, they soak up water) and slice them. Fry them in the pan with a tablespoon of oil over a high heat for 4 minutes, until they release their water and it evaporates again. Take them out.
Líquido primero: el skyr y unos 120 ml d: Liquid first: the skyr and about 120 ml of water or milk into the jug.
Listos cuando la clara está blanca y fir: Ready when the white is white and firm but the yolk wobbles when you shake the pan. Salt the white only: salt on the yolk leaves white specks.
Llena una olla con aproximadamente un li: Fill a pot with roughly a litre of water for every 100 g of pasta and put it on a high heat.
Lleva a fuego medio removiendo, y cuando: Bring it to a medium heat, stirring, and turn the heat down as soon as it starts to boil. 4 or 5 minutes, stirring often, until it thickens to a porridge.
Lleva a hervor a fuego fuerte y, desde q: Bring it to the boil over a high heat and, from the moment it bubbles, count exactly 10 minutes for a yolk that is set but not grey.
Los copos de maíz al final, justo antes: The cornflakes at the end, just before eating.
Los copos de maíz por encima al final: e: The cornflakes on top at the end: in the skyr they go soft within a couple of minutes.
Los copos de maíz, al final del todo, o: The cornflakes right at the end, or they go soft within two minutes.
Los copos de maíz, al final y justo ante: The cornflakes at the end and just before eating.
LOS COPOS DE MAÍZ, JUSTO ANTES DE COMER:: THE CORNFLAKES, JUST BEFORE EATING: in the yoghurt they soften very quickly and lose their crunch.
Lubina seca y salada, con dos cortes en: Sea bass patted dry and salted, with two cuts in the skin. Skin down, press for 10 seconds, 4 minutes; turn, 1 minute.
Lubina seca y salada, piel abajo con la: Sea bass patted dry and salted, skin down with the spatula pressing for 10 seconds, 4 minutes; turn, 1 minute.
Machaca el aguacate con sal, úntalo por: Mash the avocado with salt and spread it down the middle, leaving a 3 cm border. Add the raw spinach and the salmon without overfilling, fold the sides in and roll it up firmly.
Machaca el aguacate con un tenedor y un: Mash the avocado with a fork and a little salt, and spread it down the middle of the tortilla, leaving a 3 cm border clear.
Merluza seca y salada, a fuego medio 3 m: Hake patted dry and salted, over a medium heat 3 minutes a side, turning it ONCE and carefully. Done when it flakes apart.
Merluza seca y salada, a fuego medio con: Hake patted dry and salted, over a medium heat with a tablespoon of oil, 3 minutes a side. Turn it once only: it falls apart. Flaking = done.
Merluza seca y salada, sartén a fuego me: Hake patted dry and salted, pan over a medium heat with a tablespoon of oil, 3 minutes a side. Turn it once, carefully. Flaking = done.
Mete las salchichas y aprieta el bocadil: Put the sausages in and press the sandwich with your hand for a few seconds: compacting it stops everything escaping at the first bite.
Mete todo en el vaso de la batidora ANTE: Put everything into the blender jug BEFORE switching it on, along with the garlic, the wholemeal bread in pieces, the oil, a splash of vinegar and salt.
